breakthroughLens.name: breakthrough
breakthroughLens.requires: Retrospective PROVES or DISPROVES, E3, prior-art delta, and independent adoption or descendant impact

breakthroughLens.name: field-shift
breakthroughLens.requires: Multiple independent IMPLEMENTS, DEPLOYS, or MAINTAINS descendants through E5 or E6

standards.title: Decoding correlated errors in quantum LDPC codes

nodes.title: Quantum benchmarking and metrology
nodes.summary: Precommit benchmarks, uncertainty, resource budgets, baselines, exclusions, and stopping rules before held-out execution.
artifactRequirements: A frozen benchmark manifest with code, data, baseline, seeds, metrics, exclusions, uncertainty method, stopping rule, and content digests.
Matched accounting for wall time, CPU, GPU, FPGA, memory, energy, tuning access, and parallelism.
Raw trials and negative results sufficient to recompute every reported interval.
revalidationTriggers: Benchmark corpus, noise model, hardware, compiler, measurement method, baseline, or uncertainty procedure changes.

nodes.title: Independent quantum replication
nodes.summary: Separate control, implementation, and execution roots so a rerun cannot masquerade as independent reproduction.
artifactRequirements: At least three effective controller clusters across two organization roots, two implementation roots, and two execution environments.
Independent reconstruction from the declared method rather than only rerunning an originator-controlled image.
Disclosed conflicts, shared infrastructure, common model families, reused code, and failed replications.
revalidationTriggers: Controller relationships, implementation roots, execution environments, dependencies, or conflict disclosures change.

nodes.title: Quantum numerical reproducibility
nodes.summary: Bind quantum simulations to exact algorithms, precision, convergence tests, error bounds, and independently executable artifacts.
artifactRequirements: Executable numerical artifact with source, environment lock, deterministic seeds where applicable, and raw outputs.
Precision, conditioning, convergence, truncation, finite-size, and approximation error analysis.
Independent checker or cross-method comparison for declared invariants.
revalidationTriggers: Algorithm, precision, dependency, compiler, execution platform, checker, or error model changes.

nodes.title: Complex linear algebra
nodes.summary: Reason with complex vector spaces, operators, eigensystems, unitary maps, positivity, and numerical conditioning.
artifactRequirements: Checkable derivations and counterexamples covering spectral decomposition, unitary evolution, positive operators, and conditioning.
Exact assumptions and finite-dimensional bounds for every numerical demonstration.
revalidationTriggers: Changed operator class, dimensional assumptions, numerical method, or precision model.

nodes.title: Differential equations and Fourier methods
nodes.summary: Connect differential evolution, boundary conditions, transforms, Green functions, stability, and discretization error.
artifactRequirements: Solved analytic and numerical cases with explicit initial and boundary conditions.
Stability, convergence, discretization, and transform-convention checks.
revalidationTriggers: Equation class, boundary assumptions, discretization, solver, or transform convention changes.

nodes.title: Quantum error correction
nodes.summary: Relate stabilizer codes, detector error models, degeneracy, decoding, logical failure, and fault-tolerant resource tradeoffs.
artifactRequirements: Executable constructions for representative stabilizer and quantum LDPC codes with declared noise and decoder assumptions.
Logical-error, threshold, latency, degeneracy, finite-size, and resource analyses with uncertainty.
Counterexamples showing where a decoder or asymptotic claim fails.
revalidationTriggers: Code family, circuit, detector model, noise, decoder, metric, or resource-accounting method changes.

nodes.title: Quantum many-body systems and symmetry
nodes.summary: Use symmetry, locality, tensor structure, phase behavior, and controlled approximation across interacting quantum systems.
artifactRequirements: Cross-method results with explicit finite-size, truncation, symmetry, and boundary assumptions.
At least one adversarial case where a favored approximation or diagnostic fails.
revalidationTriggers: Hamiltonian family, symmetry, boundary, approximation, scale, or numerical method changes.

nodes.title: Quantum measurement and entanglement
nodes.summary: Reason about generalized measurement, composite systems, channels, entanglement, tomography, and operational uncertainty.
artifactRequirements: Checkable measurement and channel calculations with explicit subsystem and tensor-order conventions.
Tomography or estimation cases reporting identifiability, uncertainty, bias, and failure modes.
revalidationTriggers: Measurement model, channel assumptions, subsystem factorization, estimator, or uncertainty method changes.

nodes.title: Open quantum systems and control
nodes.summary: Model noise, dissipation, feedback, identifiability, controllability, and hardware-bounded intervention without idealizing away the environment.
artifactRequirements: Open-system dynamics with declared Markov, bath, measurement, latency, actuator, and calibration assumptions.
Robustness and identifiability checks across bounded model mismatch and control constraints.
revalidationTriggers: Noise, bath, device, calibration, feedback, actuator, latency, or safety envelope changes.

nodes.title: Quantum states and dynamics
nodes.summary: Derive state, observable, density-operator, Hamiltonian, and channel evolution with explicit conventions and limits.
artifactRequirements: Checkable derivations in state-vector and density-operator form with units and tensor conventions.
Executable closed-system and channel examples with conserved quantities and limiting cases.
revalidationTriggers: State space, Hamiltonian, channel, convention, approximation, or numerical representation changes.

nodes.title: Statistical inference and metrology
nodes.summary: Design estimators and experiments with calibration, identifiability, uncertainty, stopping rules, and multiple-comparison controls.
artifactRequirements: Precommitted estimands, sampling plan, stopping rule, exclusions, and uncertainty procedure.
Synthetic and real calibration cases exposing bias, non-identifiability, leakage, and multiple testing.
revalidationTriggers: Estimator, sampling, calibration, stopping, exclusion, or uncertainty procedure changes.

nodes.title: Tensor and spectral operators
nodes.summary: Work with tensor products, decompositions, operator norms, spectral approximations, and entanglement-relevant structure.
artifactRequirements: Checkable tensor-order, decomposition, norm, rank, truncation, and spectral-error examples.
Counterexamples for unstable decompositions and misleading low-rank approximations.
revalidationTriggers: Tensor convention, norm, decomposition, truncation, or spectral algorithm changes.

nodes.title: Season 1: correlated-noise QEC decoder garden
nodes.summary: Reproduce and extend a correlated-noise quantum LDPC decoder under frozen baselines, held-out trials, uncertainty, and matched compute and energy accounting.
artifactRequirements: Exact Version of Record, [[72,12,6]], [[90,8,10]], and [[144,12,12]] BB fixtures, p=0.001 through 0.006 circuit bundles, data, decoder, baseline, noise corpus, seed, confidence procedure, stopping rule, metric, environment, and accounting-method digests frozen before held-out execution.

For every logical-error fixture-by-physical-error-by-implementation-root-by-execution-environment cell, acceptance requires the declared minimum cases, at least 100 logical failures, a two-sided 99% interval, and relative half-width at most 30%.

Latency cells use a precommitted latency quantile and deadline, the declared minimum cases, and either a two-sided 99% quantile interval or a 99% one-sided deadline-miss upper bound; zero deadline misses may therefore be conclusive.

Logical error rate and latency with raw trials, uncertainty intervals, negative results, and matched CPU, GPU, FPGA, memory, wall-time, parallelism, tuning-access, and energy accounting; exhausting a frozen compute cap is inconclusive and cannot pass.
A rare-event method may replace direct sampling only as a separately reviewed unbiased estimator with content-digested method, review receipt, and variance-and-coverage validation.
Independent reimplementation across the declared controller, organization, implementation, and execution-environment roots.
Unexpected safety- or security-relevant results quarantined until prepublication triage permits disclosure.
revalidationTriggers: The pinned publication, data, code, baseline, code family, noise model, hardware, metric, decoder, or accounting method changes.
A result changes an adversarial accept or reject decision and requires confidential handling.
